en.title: Fluid Chocolate Sauce with Egg

steps.n1: Whisk all ingredients together until well combined.
steps.n2: Place the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly until the consistency becomes smooth and liquid.
steps.n3: You can double the ingredients to ensure enough to cover the entire cake surface.
